text:
Jordan - Sales: Quick sync — closed Nexa Health (pilot). Moving to CS onboarding. Summary below.
Jordan - Sales: Account: Nexa Health (healthtech pilot). Commitment: 3-week pilot w/ potential 10k/mo post-pilot. Security: needs SSO + SCIM, PHI data flow review required. Primary contacts: Maya (Product Lead) and Omar (IT). Expected pilot kickoff: 2026-04-05. Renewal/expansion signal: high if latency < 200ms and accuracy > baseline.
Jordan - Sales: Main risks: SSO delay, model latency on long contexts, and training calendar conflicts. Asking CS to own onboarding timeline and capture early eval feedback.
Michelle - CSM: Thanks @Jordan. I’ll pick this up. Can someone add the SSO ticket + contact in this thread? Need the exact contact for SSO admin and expected data classification.
Jordan - Sales: SSO admin is Omar (omar@nexahealth.com). He’s available next Tue afternoon. Data classification: PHI — they need encrypted-at-rest and KMS integration. Also shared: SOC2 requirements (they asked for our evidence pack).
Alejandra - CS Ops: Onboarding playbook items I’ll own and assign: 1) Kickoff meeting + goals (owner: Michelle) 2) SSO/SCIM config + test (owner: Sam Eng for support; CS to coordinate with Omar) 3) Prompt and eval baseline (owner: Michelle + Jordan) 4) Training sessions for product team (owner: Customer success) 5) Observability hooks + error escalation (owner: Rahul Support)
Alejandra - CS Ops: Adding checklist snippet for our internal tracking:
```
- Pre-kickoff: legal + SOC2 evidence shared
- Week 0: SSO envelope + SCIM test account
- Week 1: Baseline eval prompts, latency test
- Week 2: Training + runbook handover
- Pilot end: adoption review + decision meeting
```
Michelle - CSM: I’ll schedule kickoff for 2026-04-05 16:00 PT and invite Maya/Omar. Please confirm owners: Sam for SSO, Rahul for support SLAs, Alejandra for checklist tracking.
Sam - Eng: I can own SSO/SCIM config and the PHI encryption checklist. FYI we’ll need a service account and a staging SCIM mapping example. Tagging @oncall-bot for environment provisioning.
oncall-bot: env-provision request received: project=nexa-pilot, env=staging, requested-by=Sam. ETA: 4 hours.
Rahul - Support: I’ll prepare a rapid-response runbook for the pilot and a priority escalation path to Eng. Need expected traffic profile (RPS + typical sequence length) to size coverage.
Jordan - Sales: Expected traffic: ~10 req/s peak during sessions, avg sequence length ~1k tokens (chat + context). Will share sample prompts this afternoon.
Alejandra - CS Ops: Next steps we agreed on:
- Michelle: kickoff invite + capture goals (by EOD 1769803000)
- Sam: create SCIM mapping + request staging creds (ETA: 1769805200)
- Rahul: draft runbook + pager thresholds (ETA: 1769807000)
- Jordan: upload sample prompts + SOC2 evidence (ETA: 1769803600)
Alejandra - CS Ops: Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept the owner items so I can mark the checklist.
Michelle - CSM: :thumbsup: accepted for kickoff and goals.
Sam - Eng: :thumbsup: SSO/SCIM owner.
Rahul - Support: :thumbsup: runbook owner.
Jordan - Sales: Thanks team — please flag any blockers in this thread. Also, capture customer feedback during week 1 so we can feed it to product. I’ll join the 2nd-week review.
Michelle - CSM: Will add a shared doc for feedback capture and link it here once created.
Alejandra - CS Ops: Noting the renewal risk: LOW-MED. Dependency is SSO timeline. If SSO slips by >10 business days, escalate to Jordan for contractual timeline adjustments.
Michelle - CSM: Will do a pre-mortem on training attendance if sessions miss >30% of invited product stakeholders.
Sam - Eng: If we hit any PHI compliance blockers, we’ll pause data sync and notify Rahul and Alejandra immediately.
Rahul - Support: Copy. I’ll also set a dedicated Slack channel for the pilot and add relevant on-call rotations.
Jordan - Sales: Channel sounds good. Thanks everyone — will follow up with sample prompts and SOC2 bundle.
Michelle - CSM: Closing note: owners confirmed. I’ll post kickoff agenda 24 hours before meeting. :white_check_mark:
